description: Elegantly designed for guests looking for a welcoming and spacious home in Paris, this apartment was fully revamped by a French architect to combine historic grandeur with contemporary comfort. It is located in the heart of Paris, at walking distance from Notre Dame, the Seine banks, and the Marais neighborhood. The apartment itself is very calm, allowing to unwind after a long day of exploring the city.The spaceThis apartment is set in a classified historic building from 1860, located on Rue Victoria, named in honor of Queen Victoria’s visit to Paris for the 1855 World Fair.Need to store your luggage? We can help arrange its pickup before your arrival and after your departure, contact us!The apartment includes:- 1 Living room- 1 Dining room with seating for 8- 1 Fully equipped kitchen- 2 Shared bathrooms (one with bathtub and WC, and one with shower and no WC)- 1 Private bathroom (see below)- 1 Separate WC5 bedrooms arranged as follows:- Bedroom 1 with a Queensize bed and en-suite bathroom (shower, no WC)- Bedroom 2 with a Queensize bed - Bedroom 3 with a Queensize bed - Bedroom 4 with a double bed - Bedroom 5 with a double bedLiving room convertible into a bedroom: 1 sofa bed for two peopleThe apartment is ideal for 10 people and can accommodate up to 12 peopleThe surface area is 122m² / 1313ft²The apartment is equipped with:- A/C- Bath and bed linen- 5-star bedding - Toiletries (shower gel, shampoo, conditioner, toilet paper)- High speed Wifi- TV- Washer dryer - Hair dryer- Nespresso coffee machine- Water boiler- Toaster - Fridge- Induction cooking plates- Combined microwave oven- Pans and other cooking wares- Baby bed and high chair if needed- SafeWe have curated a selection of services and experiences with trusted partners to elevate your Parisian stay.
